boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented, under-21-safe activities in and around New Mexico Tech with no admission or purchase required.

cards.entity_name: Joseph R. Skeen Library community computers
cards.title: Use Skeen Library’s community computers
cards.subtitle: Joseph R. Skeen Library, 801 Leroy Place
cards.notes: Bring a valid photo ID to the circulation desk, request a two-hour community computer pass, then settle in for reference or internet use.
cards.short_summary: A free two-hour computer and internet session is available to community visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT states that Skeen Library computers for reference and internet use are available free of charge; community passes last two hours.
cards.access_notes: Bring valid photo ID to the Circulation Desk; one two-hour community computer pass may be obtained daily.

cards.entity_name: Joseph R. Skeen Library community WiFi
cards.title: Get a Skeen Library WiFi pass
cards.subtitle: Joseph R. Skeen Library, 801 Leroy Place
cards.notes: Bring a valid photo ID to the circulation desk and request a WiFi pass for your own device; use the connection for a focused catch-up session.
cards.short_summary: Community visitors can obtain a two-hour WiFi pass for personal devices.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT says community visitors may obtain a two-hour WiFi pass for their own device from Skeen Library’s Circulation Desk.
cards.access_notes: Bring valid photo ID to the Circulation Desk; WiFi passes are good for two hours.

cards.source_title: New Mexico Tech to host world-renown musicians, storytellers, actors, dancers

cards.title: Join the Socorro Fourth of July Celebration
cards.subtitle: Socorro Rodeo & Sports Complex
cards.notes: Plan around the city’s annual July 4 listing, gather friends at the Sports Complex, and enjoy the community celebration without an admission charge.
cards.short_summary: A City of Socorro annual celebration with free tickets.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Socorro listed the 33rd Annual Fourth of July Celebration at the Socorro Rodeo & Sports Complex with free tickets.
cards.source_title: 33rd Annual 4th of July Celebration — City of Socorro
cards.access_notes: The City listing marked tickets free for its 2026 event; confirm future annual-event details before attending.

cards.title: Attend a Presidential Chamber Music Series concert
cards.subtitle: Macey Center, 909 Olive Lane
cards.notes: Check NMT PAS programming, choose a listed Presidential Chamber Music Series concert, and use the Macey Center gathering as a no-purchase evening out.
cards.short_summary: NMT PAS identifies this as one of its free community programs.

cards.source_title: About PAS — New Mexico Tech Performing Arts Series
cards.access_notes: NMT PAS identifies the series as free; Macey Center’s physical address is 909 Olive Lane, Socorro.

warnings: Several documented event cards are recurring or season-specific; their cited sources establish no-cost access, but attendees should confirm a current date and availability before going.
